lead: A `Ctx` field owning a Novis reference must be released in `Drop::drop`, not left to its field drop; the failure is a refcount underflow.
body: Rust runs `Drop::drop` before dropping fields, so a field still holding a reference when the sweep at the end of that body runs is released twice, and the panic names `refcount.get() - 1` and no field. Join the `set_*(Value::null())` lines already in `Ctx::drop` for any new owning field.
